approval_scope: None. This is a proposed offline experiment on the Sparkov synthetic benchmark. It does not amend the accepted mechanics-only contract (fast-path-mechanics-v1), which stays in force and unchanged.
effective_scope: Offline use by the apps/api modelling library and Notebook 08 section 8 only. It is never read by the served API, never scores a payment, selects no operating threshold, and approves no feature for runtime.

partitioning.note: Identical to the accepted benchmark so results are comparable. The cutpoint and counts are checked against data/manifests/sparkov-mechanics-v1.manifest.json values recorded here.

search.note: Model selection uses the first chronological half of the calibration partition only. The test partition is scored once, after selection.

calibration.note: Fitted on the second chronological half of the calibration partition, which selection never used.

notes: Results from this configuration are Sparkov synthetic benchmark mechanics. They are not a production fraud-performance claim. This file holds no fraud threshold, promotion criterion, or action limit.
